sequence_description: Test OIDC SSO nonce enforcement: initiate an auth request with nonce expectation, then attempt SSO where the mock IdP omits nonce; RP must reject.
description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

sequence_description: Establish a valid baseline session via password login, then attempt OIDC SSO login where the IdP omits nonce (mutation). RP must reject nonce-less id_token even if a prior session exists (anti-replay/freshness of OIDC auth response).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_oidc_nonce_bypass_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_oidc_nonce_bypass_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: OIDC SSO accepted id_token without nonce (OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11); freshness/anti-replay binding to nonce is bypassed.

sequence_description: Test whether enabling MFA on a user is coherently enforced across alternate authentication paths (password vs enterprise SSO). Hypothesis: MFA is enforced for password login but skipped for SSO connector login, indicating step-skipping / non-atomic flow enforcement across auth methods.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_pwd_login_status >= 400 AND user_victim_sso_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_victim_pwd_login_status=200 >= 400 → False) AND (user_victim_sso_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: MFA-required user was able to establish a session via an alternate flow (SSO) or password flow without completing MFA; indicates step skipping / incoherent MFA enforcement across authentication FSM.
